mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sub_wash_coal_plan WHERE wash_coal_plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT * FROM sub_wash_coal_plan WHERE wash_coal_plan_id = #{planId} and unit_name=#{unitName} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT * FROM sub_wash_coal_plan WHERE wash_coal_plan_id IN #{pid} ORDER BY wash_coal_plan_id ASC, id ASC

SELECT SUM(wash_in_month_plan) AS wash_in_month_plan, SUM(wash_in_day_plan) AS wash_in_day_plan, SUM(clean_coal_month_plan) as clean_coal_month_plan, SUM(clean_coal_day_plan) as clean_coal_day_plan, SUM(clean_coal_month_car_plan) as clean_coal_month_car_plan, SUM(clean_coal_day_car_plan) as clean_coal_day_car_plan, SUM(slack_coal_month_plan) as slack_coal_month_plan, SUM(slack_coal_day_plan) as slack_coal_day_plan, SUM(slack_coal_month_car_plan) as slack_coal_month_car_plan, SUM(slack_coal_day_car_plan) as slack_coal_day_car_plan FROM sub_wash_coal_plan WHERE wash_coal_plan_id IN (SELECT id from wash_coal_plan where YEAR(plan_month)=YEAR(#{statsDate}) AND MONTH(plan_month)=MONTH(#{statsDate})) and unit_code=#{unitCode} GROUP BY unit_code

SELECT SUM(wash_in_month_plan) AS wash_in_month_plan, SUM(clean_coal_month_plan) as clean_coal_month_plan FROM sub_wash_coal_plan WHERE wash_coal_plan_id IN (SELECT id from wash_coal_plan where YEAR(plan_month)=YEAR(#{statsDate}) ) and unit_code=#{unitCode} GROUP BY unit_code

SELECT unit_code,unit_name,SUM(wash_in_month_plan) AS wash_in_month_plan, SUM(wash_in_day_plan) AS wash_in_day_plan, SUM(clean_coal_month_plan) as clean_coal_month_plan, SUM(clean_coal_day_plan) as clean_coal_day_plan FROM sub_wash_coal_plan WHERE wash_coal_plan_id IN (SELECT id from wash_coal_plan where plan_month=#{statsDate}) GROUP BY unit_code,unit_name

SELECT unit_code,unit_name,SUM(wash_in_month_plan) AS wash_in_month_plan, SUM(clean_coal_month_plan) as clean_coal_month_plan FROM sub_wash_coal_plan WHERE wash_coal_plan_id IN (SELECT id from wash_coal_plan where YEAR(plan_month)=YEAR(#{statsDate}) and plan_month <= #{statsDate}) GROUP BY unit_code,unit_name
